content: Rifampin reduces the plasma levels of dabrafenib by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzymes, which accelerates its metabolism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Danicopan increases the levels and effects of rifampin by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Close monitoring is advised. Additionally, danicopan increases plasma concentrations of P-gp substrates, which may necessitate dose reductions of these substrates to prevent serious adverse reactions. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of dantrolene by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the exposure of daprodustat by inducing CYP2C8 metabolism, potentially leading to a loss of efficacy. Hemoglobin levels should be monitored, and daprodustat doses adjusted when initiating or discontinuing CYP2C8 inducers. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of dapsone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of daridorexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. An alternative drug should be considered. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of darifenacin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of darolutamide, a substrate of P-gp and CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin significantly decreases the levels of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to increased metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of dasatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of daunorubicin by inducing P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels of deferasirox by inducing UGT enzymes. Avoid coadministration with potent UGT inducers. If coadministration is necessary, consider increasing the initial dose of deferasirox to 30 mg/kg and monitor ferritin levels and clinical response. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of deflazacort by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of deuruxolitinib by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP2C9 inducers. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of dexamethasone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of dexlanoprazole by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of diazepam by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may increase the elimination rate of diazepam, reducing its efficacy. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of diclofenac by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of digoxin by inducing P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of dihydroergotamine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of diltiazem by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. If coadministration is necessary, consider dosage adjustments and close monitoring of pharmacologic effects, such as blood pressure. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of disopyramide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of docetaxel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of dolutegravir by inducing UGT1A and CYP3A4 metabolism. Increase the dolutegravir dosage when coadministering with strong UGT1A/CYP3A4 inducers. Avoid rifampin in patients with integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI)-associated resistance, as this may lead to therapeutic failure and resistance development. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of donepezil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of doravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated, as it may lead to a loss of virologic response and resistance development. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of doxepin cream by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of doxorubicin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of dronabinol by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of dronedarone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of duloxetine by inducing CYP1A2 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of dutasteride by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of duvelisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers, as this may reduce duvelisib efficacy. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of edoxaban by inducing P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Avoid coadministration with potent P-gp inducers. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of efavirenz by inducing CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of elacestrant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of elafibranor by inducing metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin alters the levels of elagolix by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Limit the use of elagolix 150 mg daily with rifampin to six months. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of eletriptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of eliglustat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers, as this significantly decreases eliglustat exposure. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of eltrombopag by inducing CYP1A2 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Eltrombopag increases rifampin levels by inhibiting metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin increases the levels of eluxadoline by decreasing metabolism. Reduce the eluxadoline dose to 75 mg twice daily if coadministered with OATP1B1 inhibitors. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of elvitegravir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration, as this may lead to therapeutic failure and resistance development. Rifampin decreases the levels of enalapril by increasing metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Rifampin increases the levels of enasidenib by affecting OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and BCRP substrates. Avoid coadministration with sensitive substrates, as minimal concentration changes may lead to serious toxicities. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of encorafenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of enfortumab vedotin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. Rifampin significantly reduces the levels and effects of entrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of enzalutamide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider using an alternative drug with minimal CYP3A4 induction potential. If unavoidable, increase the enzalutamide dose to 240 mg daily. If the CYP3A4 inducer is discontinued, revert to the original enzalutamide dose. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of eplerenone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are recommended.
